properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Kimble County in west central Texas...

* WHEN...Until 845 PM CST.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

Roosevelt, Us-83 Near The Kerr-Kimble County Line, Cleo, Us-377

Park Road 73 crossing South Llano River, US HWY 377 crossing
South Llano River, RM 385 crossing Falls Prong, FM 2169 crossing
Johnson Fork Creek, US HWY 377 crossing 2 miles North of
Telegraph, County Road 430 crossing Johnson Fork, Old Segovia Rd.

along County Road 410 and KC 314 crossing Llano River.

in Junction was closed and along with the following Ranch Roads;
2291, 3480, and North 1674 were closed.

Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Flooding is occurring or is imminent. Most flood related deaths occur
in automobiles. Do not attempt to cross water covered bridges, dips,
or low water crossings. Never try to cross a flowing stream, even a
small one, on foot. To escape rising water find another route over
higher ground.

Even 6 inches of fast-moving flood water can knock you off your feet
and a depth of 2 feet will float your car. Never try to walk, swim,
or drive through such swift water. If you come upon flood waters,
stop, turn around and go another way.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.
